paragraphs: Tziyon. There was one family whom ben Tziyon forcibly distanced; Kiddushin 71a:8, Asarah Yuhasin. The Arukh explains: the name of an important man. R’ Ovadiah of Bertinoro on Eduyot 8:7 [Heilprin cites chapter 5], explains: a violent, powerful man.
